memory_candidates: Lean4: rcases/cases on a bare (non-hypothesis) expression only generalizes the goal target, not other hypotheses -- use `split at h` (not `rcases <expr> with ...`) when you need a match/if inside an already-computed hypothesis `h` to reduce.

Lean4: rename_i's 'last n inaccessible' count must include trailing auto-generated heq/let-binder names introduced by split/match compilation, not just the binders you actually want to name -- undercounting silently renames the wrong (later) inaccessible variable.
